name: Inequality and Poverty Analysis
description: An introduction to measuring and analysing inequality and poverty from a quantitative perspective, covering monetary and multidimensional approaches and drawing on national and global evidence.

name: Causal Inference for Observational and Experimental Studies
description: An advanced introduction to causal inference in the social sciences, covering experimental and observational designs including matching, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, and difference-in-differences.

name: Measuring Inequality of Opportunity
description: An introduction to measuring inequality of opportunity using Roemer's framework, covering ex-ante and ex-post approaches and comparing cells-based, parametric, and data-driven estimation methods, with a hands-on implementation in R.

name: Teaching statement
description: I want students to learn how to use quantitative methods and how to question the results those methods give them.
